An *amsim* simulation consists of several parts. Broadly speaking, the options
to specify a configuration can be grouped into *global*, *genomic*, *phenomic*,
*mating*, and *sampling and estimation* options.

## Genome options

```{bash}
../build/amsim
```

## Phenotype options

```{bash}
# run a micro-sized simulation
../build/amsim \
  --n-individuals 100 \
  --n-loci 50 \
  --save-config \
  --no-run

# look at the configuration file
cat config.toml
```
